newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH SKODA JAN OUTPUT RISES 10 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: CZECH SKODA JAN OUTPUT RISES 10 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Czech Skoda Auto a.s., a unit of Volkswagen AG, on Wednesday said its output in January rose 10 percent, year-on-year, to total 24,415 vehicles.
The firm added in a statement that its plants in Mlada Boleslav, Vrchlabi and Kvasinach together were producing more than 1,100 of Skoda's Felicia and recently-launched Octavia models a day.
Skoda expects total output and sales to rise by some 30 percent this year to 340,000, of which the mid-sized Octavia should account for over 60,000.
